title: Customer onboarding walkthrough
summary: An onboarding clerk creates a new customer in the CRM. They first search for an existing customer, then enter personal details, attach a scanned ID document and record the identity check result. The new customer waits in an approvals queue until a team manager approves it, after which the customer becomes active.

screens.name: Customer search
screens.purpose: Find an existing customer before a new one is created.

screens.name: Customer details
screens.purpose: Enter the new customer's personal details.

screens.name: Identity check
screens.purpose: Attach the customer's ID document and record whether the check passed.

screens.name: Approvals queue
screens.purpose: Hold new customers until a team manager approves them.

fields.label: Title
fields.notes: Options seen: Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr

fields.label: Email
fields.notes: Expert said it is sometimes missing

journey.description: The clerk searches by postcode and surname to check the customer does not already exist.
The clerk fills in the customer's personal details.
The clerk presses Save; the system checks the email and the date of birth.
The clerk uploads a scan of the customer's ID and records the verification result.
A team manager reviews the new customer in the approvals queue and approves it.

requirements.statement: The system must search for an existing customer by postcode and surname before a new customer record can be created.
requirements.rationale: Duplicate customer records cause problems downstream.
requirements.source_quote: We always search first, otherwise we end up with duplicates.

requirements.statement: The system must reject a customer record when the email address is not a valid format or the date of birth shows the customer is under 18.
requirements.source_quote: It checks the email looks right and that they're over eighteen; if not it just won't save.

requirements.statement: As an onboarding clerk, I need to attach a scanned ID document to the customer, so that the identity check has evidence.
requirements.source_quote: We upload the scan of their passport or driving licence here.

requirements.statement: New customers must wait in an approvals queue until a team manager approves them.
requirements.rationale: A second person checks every new customer before they become active.
requirements.source_quote: Nothing happens until a manager approves.

acceptance_criteria.given: a clerk is on the customer search screen
acceptance_criteria.when: they enter a postcode and surname and search
acceptance_criteria.then: matching customers are listed before a new one can be created

acceptance_criteria.given: a clerk has searched and found no match
the email field contains text without an @ sign
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is not saved and the email field shows an error

acceptance_criteria.given: the date of birth is less than 18 years ago
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is not saved and the date of birth field shows an error

acceptance_criteria.given: a clerk is on the identity check screen
acceptance_criteria.then: the document is attached to the customer and its name is shown

acceptance_criteria.given: a clerk has submitted the identity check
acceptance_criteria.then: the customer appears in the approvals queue with status Pending approval

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer is in the approvals queue
acceptance_criteria.then: the customer's status changes to Active

questions.question: When the search finds a possible match, does the clerk have to use it, or can they still create a new customer?
questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether the duplicate check blocks the clerk or only warns them.
questions.context_quote: If nothing comes up, we press New customer up here.

questions.question: Is the email address mandatory, or can a customer be onboarded without one?
questions.why_it_matters: Changes whether the Email field is required and what the validation does when it is empty.
questions.context_quote: Most of the time we have one. Sometimes not.

questions.question: Which document types are accepted for the ID upload, and is there a file size limit?
questions.why_it_matters: Needed to build the upload control and its error messages.
questions.context_quote: We upload the scan of their passport or driving licence here.

questions.question: Who can approve a new customer when the team manager is away?
questions.why_it_matters: Decides which roles need the Approve permission and whether there is a deputy rule.
questions.context_quote: Usually Dave does the approvals. If he's off, well, it waits.
